description: Essential for building and maintaining applications. Full-stack developers work on both the front-end and back-end of applications. Front-end developers focus on the user interface and user experience, while back-end developers work on the server-side logic and databases.
questions: "Can you tell me about a time you had to solve a complex problem related to software development and how you went about it?"
"What is your experience with front-end and back-end frameworks, and how have you applied them in your past projects?"
"Can you describe your process for testing and finding bugs in your code?"
"How do you approach working on both the user interface and the server-side of an application simultaneously?"
"In your opinion, what is the most challenging aspect of full-stack development and how have you overcome this in your past projects?"
